challenge_en: High coastal solar radiation and humidity requiring privacy without trapping indoor heat.
challenge_so: Kulaylka xeebta iyo qoyaanka sare iyadoo la rabo asturaad qoys oo aan gudaha kululayn.
solution_en: Central shaded courtyard, perforated mashrabiya wind screens, insulated double-leaf blockwork, and rooftop solar.
solution_so: Barxad dhexe oo hoos leh, shaashado hawo-mareen (mashrabiya), derbiyo kulaylka celiya, iyo solar saqafka ah.

challenge_en: Narrow urban corner plot demanding maximum retail visibility, parking flow, and natural daylighting.
challenge_so: Boos ganacsi oo gees ah oo u baahan muuqasho dukaamo, baarkin habaysan, iyo iftiin dabiici ah.
solution_en: Cantilevered 4-storey RC frame, double-height retail podium, acoustic office suites, and basement cistern.
solution_so: Dhisme 4 dabaq ah oo RC Frame ah, dukaamo salka ah, xafiisyo deggan, iyo berked biyo oo hoose.

challenge_en: Transforming a raw concrete shell into a warm East African luxury corporate residence.
challenge_so: U beddelidda dhisme qallafsan guri xarrago leh oo ku habboon martigelinta iyo ganacsiga.
solution_en: Warm travertine textures, custom mvule timber joinery, concealed linear lighting, and acoustic glazing.
solution_so: Dhagax dabiici ah, alwaax tayo sare leh, nalal qarsoon, iyo muraayado dhawaaqa celiya.

challenge_en: Extreme coastal salinity and high cooling loads requiring resilient materials and secure compound zoning.
challenge_so: Cusbo-badeedka iyo kulaylka sare oo u baahan agab adag iyo nidaam amni oo xarun hay’adeed.
solution_en: Marine-grade C40 concrete specs, shaded walkways, solar carport canopy, and zoned perimeter security.
solution_so: Shubka adag ee C40, waddooyin hoos leh, baarkin cadceedda dhaliya, iyo xayndaab amni.
